newsitem.title: IRAQ: Iraq plans to build free trade zone in Basra.
newsitem.headline: Iraq plans to build free trade zone in Basra.

text.p: Iraq plans to build a free trade zone in Basra in the south of the country, the newspaper of the ruling Baath party said on Thursday.
"The committee entrusted with building a free trade zone in Khour al-Zubair has approved the construction of the big economic project after visiting the area this week," al-Thawra said.
It said the committee decided to start work after considering the potential of Khour al-Zubair port in Basra.
The paper said the port was equipped with suitable stores of 24,000 tonnes capacity, communications, terminals with 10 million tonnes capacity a year, and transport facilities.
Earlier this month a cabinet meeting chaired by President Saddam Hussein approved a proposal to build the zone and asked the Iraqi Economic Committee to study its implementation.
Iraq is under stringent U.N. trade sanctions imposed after its 1990 invasion of Kuwait.
A United Nations oil-for-food deal which went into effect in December allows Iraq to sell $2 billion worth of oil over six months to buy food and medicine.
